provenance.note: One rotation phase of the treatment. Planting, harvest and irrigation events come from the stacked generator output, assigned to this phase by the plot ids in the Century package; planting amounts are still the generator's prior fills (prior_filled). Harvests take the harvest lookup fractions (harvest_lookup_row), or go wholly to litter for cover crops and sudangrass, which were plowed under. Harvests missing from operations_harvest.csv are filled from plot_system.csv, and cover crops end on their incorporation date. Fertilization is rebuilt from the package.

events.provenance_note: Total N applied, field average over this phase's plots. Written as mineral N in nh4_n_kg_m2; SIPNET reads nh4 + no3 as one mineral pool, so the split does not reach the model.
